metadata.rendering: verbatim message shown to the person between tool calls

archive_metadata.format: ChatGPT-style conversation mapping; local conversion, not an official provider export
archive_metadata.source_kind: Claude Cowork session transcript (Claude Agent SDK JSONL), completed public text messages
archive_metadata.message_timestamps: Transcript record times, in seconds since Unix epoch and ISO 8601; the conversation create_time is the first transcript event; a message typed while a reply was in progress carries its queue time, with its delivery time in metadata
archive_metadata.coverage: Messages typed by the person (including any sent while a reply was in progress, and interruption markers the person triggered) and the options the person selected in question cards; the assistant text shown in the chat: progress lines between tool calls, question cards rendered as text, notes and file-card captions sent through tools (phase commentary), and the reply ending each completed turn (phase final_answer); recorded through capture. A reply still in progress at capture enters only on a refresh
omitted_record_types: system, developer and harness instructions (including <system-reminder> blocks)
the continuation summaries that resume a compacted session
tool calls and outputs, except the chat-visible items named in coverage

project.name: RH4
project.source: the session context the harness records

source_transcript.note: The transcript is not stored in the repository; it contains instructions, reasoning and tool traffic that the coverage rules exclude

spool.note: Every transcript record read so far for this session, kept outside the repository so that a transcript rewritten at a compaction loses nothing already read; the conversion reads the spool
